# Relief Plus Wellness

> Professional wellness clinic in East Toronto offering acupuncture, Wet Cupping (Hijama), osteopathic therapy, Traditional Chinese Medicine, and wellness services. Located at 1403 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Z5. Open 7 days a week. Phone: +1 (416) 461-1118.
